claims.title: Periodic weighted realization

claims.title: Unbounded mean-degree coordinates
claims.statement: Both coordinates separately unbounded for all d>=3; quantitative cyclic-polytope families.

claims.title: Attainable interval
claims.statement: Every h in (3,16) occurs in dimension 3; rational h occurs periodically.

claims.title: Regular-class asymptotic comparison
claims.statement: Closure of periodic weighted-Delaunay/Laguerre harmonic degrees equals finite asymptotic raw four-polytope complexity limits; unboundedness equivalent.

claims.title: Regular-class lower bound
claims.evidence: established four-polytope flag inequality plus cap limit

claims.title: Deterministic centroidal creation
claims.statement: Explicit support family has N=22 before and N=26 after positive-time birth under mean-curvature flow for sufficiently small positive mu.
claims.evidence: analytic forward-flow unfolding plus exact symbolic enumeration

claims.title: Abrasion extensions
claims.statement: Same mechanism for nonnegative Bloore-type combinations with b+c>0; endpoint counts persist on an open set of asymmetric bodies.
claims.evidence: strict-parabolic derivative, symmetry and Morse-persistence proofs

claims.title: Distribution-free expectation failure
claims.statement: Any measure supported on the bad open set has expectation increase between fixed endpoint times.
claims.evidence: endpoint count constancy; no natural-ensemble claim

claims.title: Moment inference counterexample
claims.statement: Zero means and covariance allow E sign=-4/5 and E jump=8/5 at equal positive coefficients.

claims.title: Corrected drift criteria
claims.statement: Exact sign-probability condition; conditional symmetry sufficient; Gaussian formula and corrected 75/25 assumptions.
